Notification.definition: A punctual, typed signal that relevant state or an environmental fact has changed.

Fact.definition: A factual-executional state primitive within the Fact Base.

Premise.definition: A logical unit evaluating whether a specific fact condition holds true upon notification.

Rule.definition: Logical-causal knowledge defining which ActionIntent is produced when its guarding condition becomes satisfied.

Effect.definition: A context-mediated mutation attributable to an owner that registers its inverse when applied.

Coeffect.definition: A declared dependency or capability required by a component from its runtime environment.

Fiber.definition: An instantiated, scoped runtime instance of a component whose lifecycle is governed by a Context.

Context.definition: The runtime mediator of effects, coeffects, capability resolution, and lifecycle disposal.

CandidateIntent.definition: An untrusted, probabilistic proposal produced by an LLM interpreter from raw natural language input.

ValidatedIntent.definition: A verified, schema-compliant intent authorized for canonical state resolution.

Validator.definition: A deterministic, pure boundary engine verifying CandidateIntent schemas, references, and preconditions.

Resolver.definition: The deterministic engine computing state transitions and generating events from ValidatedIntents.

StateDiff.definition: An explicit, complete delta of modified fields transitioning GameState_before to GameState_after.

GameState.definition: The immutable canonical snapshot of all world simulation entities, rooms, and attributes.

WorkPackage.definition: A bounded unit of scoped, self-contained execution with explicit input paths, mutation authority, and acceptance criteria.

Evidence.definition: Durable, attributable observations, logs, or cryptographic hashes from which claims and postconditions are independently verified.

KnowledgePlane.definition: A KAD-owned interface for durable knowledge, governed retrieval, provenance, ingestion, and bounded context compilation.

SourceArtifact.definition: A durable authoritative artifact that outranks indexes, summaries, memories, projections, and model inference.

DerivedState.definition: Rebuildable indexes, embeddings, summaries, caches, packets, memory candidates, or wiki projections that cannot replace source artifacts.

ContextPacket.definition: A bounded, policy-filtered selection of knowledge compiled for an identified agent and task.

MemoryCandidate.definition: A provenance-attached proposed or inferred knowledge item awaiting validation and corroboration.

TinySpecialist.definition: A constrained model tier, such as Needle 2, that classifies, routes, or extracts from bounded packets.

TrustDomain.definition: An explicit boundary governing which knowledge, capabilities, principals, and context may be combined or exposed.
